entries.detail: terminal, file, web, browser, code_execution: applied, read back, and tested against real Hermes (a disabled toolset is not available to the agent).

Applied and read back; runtime behavior not tested. Disabled in Hermes: delegation, cronjob. "kanban" is always enabled (required for task reporting); delegation and cronjob are never enabled (sub-agents and cron jobs would run outside the department board).

Skills not in the allowlist (the department's plus the agent's own) are disabled in the profile (read back via Hermes). Hermes always keeps its essential skill(s) enabled (hermes-agent). Allowed ids that are not installed in the profile are ignored.
Hermes supports enabling/disabling MCP tools ("server:tool"), but this installation has no MCP server to verify against, so nothing is applied and MCP access is not claimed to be restricted.
No model chosen for the department or the agent: the profile keeps its own default model (not changed).
Hermes has no setting that prevents an agent or task from selecting a different model (tasks accept model overrides), so the chosen model is a default, not a restriction.

Department purpose, the team (teammate profiles), work rules and shared context references are written into a managed block of the profile's SOUL.md; the rest of the file is untouched. References only, not file contents.

departmentWide.detail: Each of the 1 agent(s) is its own Hermes profile. Hermes reports no per-profile cap (kanban.max_in_progress_per_profile unset), so an agent's tasks are not limited by Vibe City or Hermes.

Verified: on the local backend an agent with file tools can read and write anywhere the Hermes process can, including other departments' task folders. Disabling the file/terminal toolsets is the enforceable control.
Every agent keeps the kanban toolset (needed to report results) and can therefore create tasks. Agents are instructed to do handed-over tasks themselves (depth 1), but this is not enforced.
Hermes supports max_runtime_seconds per task; it will be set when quests are created (Milestone 3) and has not been tested.

quests.title: Set up your Chief of Staff
quests.hint: Paste your NEAR AI Cloud API key and pick the model your Chief of Staff thinks with. Every agent you hire uses the same key.

quests.title: Set up the treasury
quests.hint: Create a wallet at app.outlayer.ai/wallet/new, and paste its agent key in the safe. Funding it is optional.

quests.title: Hire your first department
quests.hint: Pick a team from the templates. Each one comes with its agents and their jobs.

quests.title: List on the Agent Market
quests.hint: Ask your Chief of Staff to list one floor as an agent on market.near.ai. Done once that floor's agents hold the agent token.

quests.title: Win your first job
quests.hint: Go live on market.near.ai; a buyer hires your listed floor and accepts its first delivery.

quests.title: Fund the IPO
quests.hint: Hold at least 4 NEAR in the company wallet: the IPO spends it on the company's Sputnik DAO and city token.

quests.title: IPO
quests.hint: Press IPO in the safe: the company wallet creates the Sputnik DAO (you approve) and the city token, all owned by the DAO.

quests.title: Connect Hyperliquid
quests.hint: At app.outlayer.ai/connect/hyperliquid, store the trading caps (max order, daily volume, leverage) for the company wallet, then check here.

quests.title: Connect Polymarket
quests.hint: At app.outlayer.ai/connect/polymarket, store the caps (max order, daily volume) for the company wallet, then check here.
